<bookmark mark='fan'/>But a slanting line of seven centimetres could point in any direction on the paper.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We would not know where to place the other corners from that line.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>When you plan a construction, start with a length that is known and lies straight.
